task.title: Remove deprecated CodeWiki skill surfaces
task.summary: Make package skill discovery expose only decision, planning, and implementation workflow skills by removing generic router/validation skill folders and moving required invariant prose to prompt/docs.

goal.outcome: Only codewiki-decision, codewiki-planning, and codewiki-implementation remain discoverable package skills while gateway/root cleanup preserves current behavior until reload.
acceptance: Package skill discovery and source-contract tests report exactly the three normal workflow skills.
`skills/codewiki/**` and `skills/codewiki-validation/**` no longer remain as package-discoverable folders, hidden aliases, or shim skills.
Bootstrap/router/validation guidance needed by agents is moved to prompt contract, package docs, or non-skill docs.
Prompt contract describes three loops plus gates, not a four-loop validation workflow.
No package source imports from `src/validation/**`; all references use `src/gateway/**`, loop gate helpers, or public API contracts.
`src/validation/**` is removed rather than retained as a compatibility shim root.
File-structure/source-contract no longer treat `src/validation/**` as an active source root except historical refs.
Gateway preflight/report semantics and pass/fail/block output remain unchanged.
Implementation notes include the exact point where the user must run `/reload`; agents must not use newly changed prompt/skill behavior before reload.
Source code no longer defines canonical diff_table, diff-table, Diff Table, or wiki_diff_table surfaces except historical test fixtures or explicitly scoped migration notes with deletion triggers.
Decision Table tool/schema/types use decision_table/DecisionTable naming and integrate with trace.decision.decision_table.
Build/gateway/graph/resume code consumes Decision Table fields directly rather than normalizing old diff_table payloads.
Skills/docs/user-facing text describe Decision Tables, not diff tables.
Product UI surfaces are deprecated for now; active docs/tasks/tests focus on backend APIs, tools, traces, compilers, gateway, graph lenses, and runtime.
Pi TUI ASCII/Unicode rendering of canonical system diagram YAML is the only retained future UI direction.
`/wiki status`, `/wiki-status`, and `/wiki_status` status UI surfaces are deprecated and not promoted as user entrypoints; backend status remains available through `wiki_state` and graph lenses.
Tests cover Decision Table tool behavior, old diff-table absence, status UI deprecation, and backend status availability where source-contract/lexicon rules require it.
non_goals: Do not remove backend `wiki_state` status/graph lenses.
Do not implement Board, Map, Product/System navigation panels, status panel, or status dock UI now.
Do not implement full lifecycle trace storage or graph view migration.
Do not change task-close/ship-ready policy except import/root cleanup.
Do not add wiki_diff_table to wiki_decision_table aliases or shims.
Do not migrate all historical .codewiki runtime/build artifacts in one sweep.
Do not make Pi TUI renderer output canonical truth.
verification: grep/import scan for diff_table, diff-table, Diff Table, wiki_diff_table in active source/docs
grep/import scan for promoted status UI command/surface wording in active source/docs

delta.desired: Three discoverable workflow skills only, no deprecated validation shim source root, prompt/docs preserve three-loop plus gate invariants, Decision Table is the clean-cut source/tool/schema surface, and active UX work is deprecated except future Pi TUI ASCII diagram rendering from canonical system diagram YAML.
delta.current: Deprecated skill/source roots and old diff-table naming are being removed; status UI/status dock work must be reset to backend-only deprecation semantics after the accepted UI decision.
delta.closure: Tests and audits prove only three workflow skills remain, src/validation imports are gone, Decision Table naming is direct with no old-name shim, status UI surfaces are deprecated/not promoted, backend status remains available through wiki_state, and user gets an explicit /reload handoff after package prompt/skill changes.
